mapper.select: SELECT a.apr20_relate_ics_id AS relate_ics_id , a.apr20_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , b.ics01_content AS content , b.ics01_submit_to AS submit_to , b.ics01_related_law AS related_law , a.apr20_deadline_id AS deadline_id , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name , c.sch03_note AS deadline_note , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , a.apr20_stand_cd AS stand_code , a.apr20_stand_date AS stand_date , a.apr20_close_date AS close_date , a.apr20_stand_yn AS stand_yn FROM apr20_relate_ics a INNER JOIN ics01_class_tree b ON a.apr20_class_tree_id = b.ics01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_deadline_id = a.apr20_deadline_id AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') WHERE 1=1 AND apr20_appr_id = #{apprId}

SELECT NULL::numeric AS relate_ics_id , b.ics01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_ics_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.ics01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , b.ics01_content AS content , b.ics01_submit_to AS submit_to , CASE WHEN #{withLaw} THEN b.ics01_related_law END AS related_law , c.sch03_deadline_id AS deadline_id , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name , c.sch03_note AS deadline_note , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , NULL AS stand_code , NULL::date AS stand_date , NULL::date AS close_date , NULL AS stand_yn FROM ics01_class_tree b LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_deadline_id = #{deadlineId} AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3') WHERE b.ics01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}

SELECT NULL::numeric AS relate_ics_id , b.icr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_icr_class_tree_nm_allpath(b.icr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name , b.icr01_content AS content , b.icr01_submit_to AS submit_to , b.icr01_related_law AS related_law , c.sch03_deadline_id AS deadline_id , f_get_deadline_nm(c.sch03_deadline_id, '2') AS deadline_full_name , c.sch03_note AS deadline_note , f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS cycle_name , NULL AS stand_code , NULL::date AS stand_date , NULL::date AS close_date , NULL AS stand_yn FROM icr01_class_tree b LEFT OUTER JOIN sch03_deadline c ON c.sch03_deadline_id = #{deadlineId} AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('6','7') WHERE b.icr01_class_tree_id = #{classTreeId}
SELECT f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) FROM sch03_deadline c WHERE c.sch03_deadline_id = #{deadlineId} AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('6','7')
SELECT f_cdnm('CycleCode', c.sch03_cycle_cd, c.sch03_company_id, f_sysdate()) FROM sch03_deadline c WHERE c.sch03_deadline_id = #{deadlineId} AND c.sch03_schedule_cd IN ('2','3')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr20_relate_ics (apr20_relate_ics_id, apr20_appr_id, apr20_class_tree_id, apr20_stand_cd, apr20_stand_date, apr20_close_date, apr20_deadline_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{apprId}, #{classTreeId}, #{standCode}, #{standDate}, #{closeDate}, #{deadlineId})

INSERT INTO bbs02_notice (bbs02_notice_id, bbs02_company_id, bbs02_title, bbs02_notice, bbs02_from_date, bbs02_to_date, bbs02_open_yn, bbs02_notice_type, bbs02_notice_detail_cd, bbs02_public_yn, bbs02_create_date, bbs02_user_nm) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{companyId}, #{title}, #{notice}, f_sysdate()::date, f_sysdate()::date, '알림', '02', NULL, 'false', f_sysdate(), 'system')
INSERT INTO bbs03_target (bbs03_target_id, bbs03_notice_id, bbs03_person_id) VALUES (#{targetId}, #{noticeId}, #{personId})
mapper.select: SELECT sys10_file_id AS file_id , sys10_parent_id AS parent_id , sys10_file_nm AS file_name , (COALESCE(sys10_stamp_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS stamp_yn FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = #{apprId} AND sys10_file_yn like 'true' AND COALESCE(sys10_title_yn, 'false') <> 'true' ORDER BY 1
